resources.string: Everywhere — YouTube, Instagram, Google, Gallery — blurs photos and videos that show a woman.
Once: on the page that opens, find “iPhon Muslim” and turn it on (Accessibility → Installed services → iPhon Muslim → On).
If it won\'t turn on and says “Restricted setting”: tap the button below → ⋮ (top) → “Allow restricted settings”, then try again.
The whole photo or video that shows a woman
Only the woman herself (head and body)
Everything runs on the phone; no internet is needed and nothing is sent. The app recognizes a woman by her face and can sometimes be wrong.
iPhon Muslim: blurs photos and videos that show a woman. No data is collected or sent.
Fast mode is needed for scrolling and video. After each phone restart, tap “Start now” once.
